title: SearchCatalogItemsRequest
description: Defines the request body for the [SearchCatalogItems](api-endpoint:Catalog-SearchCatalogItems) endpoint.

text_filter.description:
The text filter expression to return items or item variations containing specified text in
the `name`, `description`, or `abbreviation` attribute value of an item, or in
the `name`, `sku`, or `upc` attribute value of an item variation.

category_ids.description: The category id query expression to return items containing the specified category IDs.

stock_levels.description:
The stock-level query expression to return item variations with the specified stock levels.
See [SearchCatalogItemsRequestStockLevel](#type-searchcatalogitemsrequeststocklevel) for possible values

enabled_location_ids.description: The enabled-location query expression to return items and item variations having specified enabled locations.

cursor.description: The pagination token, returned in the previous response, used to fetch the next batch of pending results.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. The default value is 100.

sort_order.description:
The order to sort the results by item names. The default sort order is ascending (`ASC`).
See [SortOrder](#type-sortorder) for possible values

product_types.description: The product types query expression to return items or item variations having the specified product types.

custom_attribute_filters.description:
The customer-attribute filter to return items or item variations matching the specified
custom attribute expressions. A maximum number of 10 custom attribute expressions are supported in
a single call to the [SearchCatalogItems](api-endpoint:Catalog-SearchCatalogItems) endpoint.

archived_state.description: The query filter to return not archived (`ARCHIVED_STATE_NOT_ARCHIVED`), archived (`ARCHIVED_STATE_ARCHIVED`), or either type (`ARCHIVED_STATE_ALL`) of items.

x-enum-elements.name: ARCHIVED_STATE_NOT_ARCHIVED
x-enum-elements.description: Requested items are not archived with the `is_archived` attribute set to `false`.

x-enum-elements.name: ARCHIVED_STATE_ARCHIVED
x-enum-elements.description: Requested items are archived with the `is_archived` attribute set to `true`.

x-enum-elements.name: ARCHIVED_STATE_ALL
x-enum-elements.description: Requested items can be archived or not archived.

ArchivedState.description:
Defines the values for the `archived_state` query expression 
used in [SearchCatalogItems](api-endpoint:Catalog-SearchCatalogItems) 
to return the archived, not archived or either type of catalog items.

x-enum-elements.name: APPOINTMENTS_SERVICE
x-enum-elements.description: A service that can be booked using the Square Appointments app.

x-enum-elements.name: FOOD_AND_BEV
x-enum-elements.description: A food or beverage item that can be sold by restaurants and other food venues.

x-enum-elements.name: EVENT
x-enum-elements.description: An event which tickets can be sold for, including location, address, and times.

x-enum-elements.name: DIGITAL
x-enum-elements.description: A digital item like an ebook or song.

x-enum-elements.name: DONATION
x-enum-elements.description: A donation which site visitors can send for any cause.

x-enum-elements.name: LEGACY_SQUARE_ONLINE_SERVICE
x-enum-elements.description: A legacy Square Online service that is manually fulfilled. This corresponds to the `Other` item type displayed in the Square Seller Dashboard and Square POS apps.

x-enum-elements.name: LEGACY_SQUARE_ONLINE_MEMBERSHIP
x-enum-elements.description: A legacy Square Online membership that is manually fulfilled. This corresponds to the `Membership` item type displayed in the Square Seller Dashboard and Square POS apps.

CatalogItemProductType.description: The type of a CatalogItem. Connect V2 only allows the creation of `REGULAR` or `APPOINTMENTS_SERVICE` items.

CustomAttributeFilter.description:
Supported custom attribute query expressions for calling the
[SearchCatalogItems](api-endpoint:Catalog-SearchCatalogItems)
endpoint to search for items or item variations.

custom_attribute_definition_id.description:
A query expression to filter items or item variations by matching their custom attributes'
`custom_attribute_definition_id` property value against the the specified id.
Exactly one of `custom_attribute_definition_id` or `key` must be specified.

key.description:
A query expression to filter items or item variations by matching their custom attributes'
`key` property value against the specified key.
Exactly one of `custom_attribute_definition_id` or `key` must be specified.

string_filter.description:
A query expression to filter items or item variations by matching their custom attributes'
`string_value`  property value against the specified text.
Exactly one of `string_filter`, `number_filter`, `selection_uids_filter`, or `bool_filter` must be specified.

number_filter.description:
A query expression to filter items or item variations with their custom attributes
containing a number value within the specified range.
Exactly one of `string_filter`, `number_filter`, `selection_uids_filter`, or `bool_filter` must be specified.

selection_uids_filter.description:
A query expression to filter items or item variations by matching  their custom attributes'
`selection_uid_values` values against the specified selection uids.
Exactly one of `string_filter`, `number_filter`, `selection_uids_filter`, or `bool_filter` must be specified.

bool_filter.description:
A query expression to filter items or item variations by matching their custom attributes'
`boolean_value` property values against the specified Boolean expression.
Exactly one of `string_filter`, `number_filter`, `selection_uids_filter`, or `bool_filter` must be specified.

Range.description: The range of a number value between the specified lower and upper bounds.

min.description:
The lower bound of the number range. At least one of `min` or `max` must be specified.
If unspecified, the results will have no minimum value.

max.description:
The upper bound of the number range. At least one of `min` or `max` must be specified.
If unspecified, the results will have no maximum value.

SearchCatalogItemsRequestStockLevel.description: Defines supported stock levels of the item inventory.

x-enum-elements.name: DESC
x-enum-elements.description: The results are returned in descending (e.g., newest-first or Z-A) order.

x-enum-elements.name: ASC
x-enum-elements.description: The results are returned in ascending (e.g., oldest-first or A-Z) order.

SortOrder.description: The order (e.g., chronological or alphabetical) in which results from a request are returned.
